name: Ju-Ju Heaps
summary: On the Echo Isles, Un'thuwa asks you to destroy Zalazane's ju-ju heaps. Their corruption threatens Durotar's flow of magic.

sections.title: Tainted Heaps
sections.body: From Sen'jin Village, Un'thuwa asks you to destroy the heaps Zalazane placed among his huts on the main Echo Isle. The tainted fetishes corrupt wildlife and strengthen warlocks and infernal creatures. Left alone, they may change Durotar's flow of magic forever.

sections.title: Un'thuwa's Sense
sections.body: Un'thuwa senses the heaps have been destroyed. With time and luck, she believes Durotar's magic will return to its normal flow. She praises your deed for your people and says you have proved your worth to the Horde's classes.

faq.answer: Zalazane, a warlock of the Echo Isles, placed the tainted heaps among his huts on the main isle.
The heaps corrupt wildlife and strengthen warlocks and infernal creatures.
Zalazane placed them among his huts on the main Echo Isle.

faq.q: Who asks me to destroy them?
faq.answer: Un'thuwa in Sen'jin Village asks you to destroy the ju-ju heaps.

faq.q: Why does Durotar's magic matter here?
faq.answer: The heaps disrupt Durotar's normal flow of magic. If they remain, that flow may change forever.

angles.text: Un'thuwa calls this a deed for your people and says you have proved your worth to the Horde's classes.
